items.t: 34 houses sold in Central Lonsdale, North Vancouver at a median of $1,934,375 (middle half $1,751,250 to $2,202,750). A typical house in Central Lonsdale, North Vancouver spent 18 days on the market and closed at 96.1% of the asking price.

In Central Lonsdale, North Vancouver, townhomes sold at a median of $1,235,000 across 41 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,050,000 and $1,450,000. The median townhome sat 14 days and sold for 97.5% of list.
Central Lonsdale, North Vancouver: 142 condos sold at a median of $791,000, with the middle half between $637,000 and $938,000. The median condo took 18 days to sell and closed at 97.7% of list.

36 duplexes sold in Central Lonsdale, North Vancouver at a median of $1,700,000 (middle half $1,534,500 to $1,926,750). A typical duplex in Central Lonsdale, North Vancouver spent 22 days on the market and closed at 97.6% of the asking price.

How Central Lonsdale compares with the rest of North Vancouver

items.t: Of 27 North Vancouver sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Central Lonsdale ranks 16th highest at $1,934,375; the range is $1,516,500 (Norgate) to $2,600,000 (Forest Hills NV). Seymour NV ($1,930,000) sits just below and Indian River ($2,004,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in Central Lonsdale have the 11th highest median of 14 North Vancouver sub-areas, $1,235,000. Mosquito Creek is lowest at $1,105,000 and Edgemont highest at $1,707,000. Westlynn ($1,150,000) sits just below and Seymour NV ($1,245,000) sits just above.

Of 12 North Vancouver sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Central Lonsdale ranks 6th highest at $791,000; the range is $542,000 (Pemberton) to $980,000 (Northlands). Harbourside ($775,000) sits just below and Norgate ($794,000) sits just above.
